notes.title: Wargame Fest Update
notes.content:
New AI Unit

Music can be lowered

notes.title: Wargame Fest Preparation: Unit Highlight and Artillery Movement
notes.content:
New changes:

When units are selected it is now easier to tell the direction the units are pointing.

Default artillery and horse artillery move faster.

notes.title: Wargame Fest Preparation: Units Rotation Fix
notes.content:
All units now have the same rotation speed so they can be controlled easier.

Unit rotation speed was set to 30 for all units.

notes.title: Wargame Fest Preparation: Unit Color and Unit movement
notes.content:
In preparation for the Wargame fest and the expected player spike the following changes were made.

Owned units are now green so players are not confused regarding the units they own / control.

When moving multiple highlighted units using right click the units will keep the formation.

notes.title: Last update had bugs so there was a rollback
notes.content: Last update had bugs so there was a rollback

notes.title: Unit formation movement update
notes.content: [b]When selecting multiple units and pressing right mouse button the units will now keep the formation[/b]

notes.title: Switching sides is now fixed
notes.content: You can now betray your nation by switching sides.

notes.title: Bug Fix: AI will not insta spawn when players spawn units
notes.content: Bug Fix: AI will not insta spawn when players spawn units

notes.title: AI waves balancing and more passive ai
notes.content:
More passive AI was added (Horses and infantry)

The agressive AI was nerfed so waves of enemies take longer

notes.title: New AI, Bug Fixes and Live Service
notes.content:
Ai -  A new type of enemy was added, check it out.
Music - Music ws added to improve vibes
Bug Fixes - Players can now spawn units flawlessly.

Live Service - As the developer I'm interested in turning the game into a Helldivers2 / Escape From Tarkov type of game. The option is to add a home region where you can upgrade your army, units and officer so there is a social place. there should also be a map / mission picking area where missions can be started to recieve xp and other rewards to level up your character. Disclaimer: I'm working on my other game Hardcore Survival but the live service layer could take from 1 to 2 weeks of active development.
